observations: White-framed windows and trees, reddish desks and chairs, cream walls, radiators, ceiling and floor. No blackboard in this view.
Left turn moves existing windows right; large right window exits right; final view keeps windows on right.
Actual reference is Round3 F123, not archived i3 F121. It differs visibly from the Blender proxy in window framing, furniture contours, lighting and materials.
Prompt gives geometry/motion priority to the proxy and appearance priority to the reference; this resolves conflicting instructions but DOES NOT remove underlying geometric discrepancies.
RGB keep_steps=5 is soft conditioning; first-frame matching, gray filling and motion following are not guaranteed. No mask or pixel pasteback is used.
remaining_modeling_and_generation_risks: Reference/proxy mismatch may still cause boundary changes or shape drift.
Pure rotation does not validate depth; hidden chairs and unseen room geometry remain assumptions.
